rival: reverse template order AND mirror each mask horizontally
canonical_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (first-empty-row (let loop
                                      ((r 0))
                                      (cond
                                        ((>= r h) h)
                                        ((for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (zero? (at g r c))) r)
                                        (else (loop (+ r 1))))))
                (top-h first-empty-row)
                (runs (let loop
                           ((cx 0) (acc (list)))
                           (cond
                             ((>= cx w) (reverse acc))
                             ((zero? (at g 0 cx)) (loop (+ cx 1) acc))
                             (else (let* ((run-color (at g 0 cx))
                                          (run-end (let find-end
                                                        ((cc cx))
                                                        (cond
                                                          ((>= cc w) cc)
                                                          ((zero? (at g 0 cc)) cc)
                                                          (else (find-end (+ cc 1)))))))
                                     (loop run-end
                                           (cons (list cx (- run-end 1) run-color) acc)))))))
                (swatches (filter (lambda (r) (!= (third r) 5)) runs))
                (template-bounds (filter (lambda (r) (= (third r) 5)) runs))
                (template-mats (for/list ((tb template-bounds))
                                 (let* ((cs (first tb))
                                        (ce (second tb)))
                                   (for/list ((r (range 0 top-h)))
                                     (for/list ((cx (range cs (+ ce 1)))) (at g r cx))))))
                (swatch-colors (map third swatches))
                (color-to-template (make-hash)))
           (for ((i (range 0 (length swatch-colors))))
             (hash-set! color-to-template
                        (list-ref swatch-colors i)
                        (list-ref template-mats i)))
           (let* ((layout-cells (for*/list ((r (range first-empty-row h)) (cx (range 0 w))
                                    #:when
                                    (!= (at g r cx) 0))
                                  (list r cx)))
                  (layout-rs (map first layout-cells))
                  (layout-cs (map second layout-cells))
                  (l-r1 (min-list layout-rs))
                  (l-r2 (max-list layout-rs))
                  (l-c1 (min-list layout-cs))
                  (l-c2 (max-list layout-cs))
                  (layout-h (+ 1 (- l-r2 l-r1)))
                  (layout-w (+ 1 (- l-c2 l-c1)))
                  (tmpl-h top-h)
                  (tmpl-w (+ 1
                             (- (second (first template-bounds))
                                (first (first template-bounds))))))
             (build-grid (* layout-h tmpl-h)
                         (* layout-w tmpl-w)
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((lr (quotient r tmpl-h))
                                (lc (quotient c tmpl-w))
                                (tr (remainder r tmpl-h))
                                (tc (remainder c tmpl-w))
                                (layout-color (at g (+ l-r1 lr) (+ l-c1 lc)))
                                (template (hash-ref color-to-template layout-color))
                                (tmpl-val (list-ref (list-ref template tr) tc)))
                           (casev tmpl-val (hash 5 layout-color) 0)))))))
